response.justification: Bogdan is a strong senior individual contributor with deep, broad engineering experience (18+ years) and genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, CI/CD infrastructure, testing libraries, MCP code generators). However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 2+ years of formal people management and 3+ years of technical leadership over teams, which his resume does not demonstrate — his career is IC-track throughout, with leadership shown mainly via workshops, open-source projects, and a small founder-led side project. Mobile platform exposure is also limited to a single stint nearly a decade ago.
strengths: Extensive developer-tools and testing-infrastructure experience (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium courses, CI/CD and DevOps setup)
18+ years of broad, hands-on software development across web, mobile, embedded, and high-scale backend systems
Demonstrated knowledge sharing and community leadership through workshops, talks, and mentoring-style courses
concerns: No formal people-management experience; role requires 2+ years managing engineers with 1:1s and performance responsibility
No evidence of leading organizational change or owning team roadmaps in a management capacity
Mobile-platform experience is dated (2015–2016 iOS/Apple TV) and shallow relative to the role's mobile ecosystem focus

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure background
